documents.title: Noting In The Board Meeting Dated 29.10.2026 Delay In Submission Of Shareholding Pattern Under Reg 31(1)(B) To NSE.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Menon Bearings Limited reported consolidated total income growth of 58.60% for Q2 FY27 compared to the same period last year. Management projects revenue growth of over 30% for FY27 and FY28, supported by expanding domestic sales and growth in US exports. The company plans to deploy automation and AI-driven visual inspection systems over the next 9 to 12 months to improve productivity and mitigate rising manpower costs. Management targets EBITDA margins of around 23% for the next year while funding capital expenditures primarily through internal accruals. Menon Bearings Limited presented its Q2 & H1FY27 investor presentation detailing consolidated financial results and strategic initiatives.

guidance.claim: Management expects growth of over 30% in FY27 and expects more than 30% growth again in FY28.
guidance.quote: There will be more than 30% growth for this year, FY27, and similarly in '27-'28 also we expect, if all the things are in place, it will be more than 30% again, with the growth drivers are basically domestic and whatever export that USA exports are growing rapidly.

guidance.claim: The company expects additional business of around INR 30 crores on a consolidated basis for FY27.
guidance.quote: And what I feel, that considering the current business pipeline and the commercial discussions and RFQs that we have received, for '26-'27, additional business expected is around INR 30 crores on consolidated basis.

guidance.claim: Estimated additional business for FY28 is expected to be INR 131 crores.
guidance.quote: And for '27-'28, we expect that estimated additional business will be of INR 131 crores, so that, the growth rate will be obviously more than 30%, with '28-'29, the growth driver, we are having the list of all customers also from whom we are estimated to get the business, RFQs are there, and discussions are going on, commercials have been finalized.

guidance.claim: Management expects additional business of INR 157 crores in 2029, excluding potential European business.
guidance.quote: And with this, for 2029, we expect additional business of INR 157 crores, excluding potential business of INR 35 crores of Europe that we estimate it will take little more time, but 100% we are going to convert that.

guidance.claim: Management stated that INR 360 crores is a conservative revenue target for the year.
guidance.quote: INR360 crores, I would say is a conservative figure and we will stick to that.

guidance.claim: Management targets Alkop segment revenue of INR 100 crores for this year and around INR 125 crores next year.
guidance.quote: For this year, we are targeting Alkop for INR100 crores, next year around INR125 crores.

guidance.claim: Management sets an internal conservative target of 20% plus year-on-year growth.
guidance.quote: You see, there is always a target, we have set ourselves on a conservative basis of 20% plus year on year.

guidance.claim: Management expects export share to increase to 37% of total revenue by next year.
guidance.quote: As we expect that by next year, the export may go up to 37% after total revenue.

guidance.claim: Total potential additional business for the current and next financial year is estimated between INR 65 crores and INR 75 crores.
guidance.quote: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores, subject to good monsoon and geopolitical situation doesn't worsen further.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in the replacement market has risen substantially across brakes and bearings segments.
demand_outlook.quote: You see, you can see our business so far as market is concerned, replacement market that has gone up substantially, maybe in brakes as well as in Menon Bearing.

demand_outlook.claim: A recent tour to Europe generated potential business of over INR 35 crores expected to convert into sales in FY28 and FY29.
demand_outlook.quote: Along with that, our recently Europe tour is yielding a significant increase in the business and potential of more than INR 35 crores that will be converted into the actual sale in the year '27-'28 and '28-'29.

demand_outlook.claim: OEM business grew by nearly 50% and exports grew by over 75% compared to the same quarter last year.
demand_outlook.quote: We can see there is a growth as compared to the same quarter last year. There is a growth in OEM's business by almost 50%, and similarly there is a growth in export more than 75%.

demand_outlook.claim: Automotive segment accounts for roughly 60% to 65% of total revenue.
demand_outlook.quote: You see, at present, the segment-wise revenue, if you break up, so from auto, we are having almost 60% to 65%, and others is engineering and other applications.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: While the global business environment continues to present certain uncertainties, the underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic tractor segment demand may be slightly affected by monsoon conditions but is expected to improve.
demand_outlook.quote: You see, considering the monsoon position that may -- in tractor segment affect today to some extent, not larger, because in some parts there is a drought-like situation, but it is expected to improve within this month or next month.

capex_expansion.claim: Automation and AI visual inspection systems will be implemented over the next 9 to 12 months.
capex_expansion.quote: So in the next 9 to 12 months, a lot of automation and visual systems are getting in place where we save on manpower, we save on time that leads in productivity, and quality is more focused.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to invest INR 5 crores in Menon Alkop and around INR 4 crores in Menon Bearings over the next 12 to 15 months.
capex_expansion.quote: But these are the next two years, next 12 months to 15 months plan, investment plan. So INR 5 crores in Alkop and around INR4 crores in bearing.

capex_expansion.claim: Brake division fully deployed ₹0.58 crore capex in FY26 with an additional ₹2.50 crore planned over the next 2 years.
capex_expansion.quote: ₹0.58 crore fully deployed in FY26 with ₹2.50 crore additional planned over next 2 years

capex_expansion.claim: Five robotic automation initiatives are rolling out between Nov 2026 and Apr 2027 to lift productivity and quality.
capex_expansion.quote: Five initiatives rolling out Nov 2026 – Apr 2027 to lift productivity, quality and machine utilization

capex_expansion.claim: Menon Bearings is investing INR 9 crores to INR 10 crores this financial year to increase bi-metal capacity by 25% to 30%.
capex_expansion.quote: If you go through the presentation, Rucheeta, you will come to know that we are investing about INR9 crores to INR10 crores of rupees for this year, this financial year for increasing the capacity and which is expected to increase the capacity by almost 25% to 30%, which may yield the total revenue of more than INR25 crores, which can generate revenue of INR25 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has planned a CapEx of around INR 4 crores for the Alkop segment this year.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are having the CapEx of around INR4 crores of for this year in Alkop alone.

capex_expansion.claim: Future CapEx is expected to yield an asset turnover of around 2.5.
capex_expansion.quote: See, whatever future CapEx that we are going to do, the additional CapEx will have asset turn of around 2.5.

capex_expansion.claim: Around 25,000 to 30,000 square feet out of the newly constructed 65,000 square feet building remains available for machine installation.
capex_expansion.quote: Factory building, whatever we have just constructed, which is 65,000 square feet, out of which almost 25,000 to 30,000 square feet is still available for expansion, where we are going to have the machines installed, which have been already ordered.

margins_costs.claim: Input costs increased with tin rising by 72%, copper by 50%, and steel by 12%.
margins_costs.quote: Just to put in numbers, tin has increased by 72%, copper by 50%, steel by 12%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins stand at 30% to 35% in Brakes, 18% to 19% in Alkop, and 23% in Bearings.
margins_costs.quote: In Alkop, it is 18% to 19%, whereas in Bearing, it is 23%, okay?

margins_costs.claim: Management is targeting EBITDA margins of about 23% for next year.
margins_costs.quote: And what we are targeting for next year, the EBITDA margins will be about 23%.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margins are expected to be sustained around 20% to 21% over time.
margins_costs.quote: But overall, on a consolidated basis, if you see, we will sustainaround 20% to 21% of margins over a period of time.

margins_costs.claim: The bi-metal segment reported EBITDA margins of around 21% plus, while Alkop achieved almost 21% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Okay. So, for the bi-metal is concerned the margin, so, EBITDA margins are around 21% plus. Then Alkop, it is almost 21%.

margins_costs.claim: Menon Brakes achieved an EBITDA margin of 25% in Q1 FY27 due to a favorable product mix.
margins_costs.quote: And now, for this quarter, in brakes, we have achieved 25%.

margins_costs.claim: Consumable carbide tools required for manufacturing have seen price increases of 300%.
margins_costs.quote: Consumables, for example, carbide tools for all manufacturers, all automobile carbide tools are required.Those carbide tools price are increased by 300%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates around 16 bearing production lines with nearly 90 semi-automatic machines being converted to single-piece flow.
orders_capacity.quote: There are almost 16 such lines on which we are getting production of various bearings. So these were all semi-automatic machines which are to the tune of almost 90 in numbers.

orders_capacity.claim: Menon Alkop has developed around 54 parts over the past two years, with start of business initiated.
orders_capacity.quote: For Menon Alkop, we have developed around 54 parts in the last two years, and they all SOB has begun.

orders_capacity.claim: Components developed or under development for several clients hold an annual revenue potential of approximately ₹55 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: These components hold a revenue potential of approximately ₹55 crore annually.

orders_capacity.claim: Peak revenue potential from the bi-metal bearing segment alone is above INR 400 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Peak revenue from this, it can be aboveINR400 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Management has funded all capital expenditures through internal accruals without taking term loans for over six months.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, basically what we have done in the past for more than six months, we have not availed any term loan. Whatever CapEx that we are doing, that is out of internal accruals, which are definitely having the impact on the cash accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital limits are accessed at 4.65% to 4.75% with a government subvention of 2.75%.
capital_allocation.quote: Apart from that, we are availing packing credit limit from bankers, which is now available at the rate of 4.65%, 4.75% only.

capital_allocation.claim: CapEx for both bi-metal and Alkop segments will be entirely funded through internal accruals without taking fresh debt.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, so far as whatever we are considering so far as bi-metal and Alkop is concerned, it will be through internal accruals only, no fresh loan will be taken.

risks_headwinds.claim: Merchant export orders were delayed over the past three months due to backlogs caused by war and disruptions at the Strait of Hormuz.
risks_headwinds.quote: But last three months, those merchant export orders were stuck because of backlog because of the Straight of Hormuz and the war.

risks_headwinds.claim: Basic shipping cargo and domestic Indian transportation costs have increased significantly.
risks_headwinds.quote: Basic ship cargo transportation has increased significantly. Indian transport has increased.

management_commitments.claim: Management projects over 30% growth for FY27 and expects more than 30% growth again in FY28.
management_commitments.quote: There will be more than 30% growth for this year, FY27, and similarly in '27-'28 also we expect, if all the things are in place, it will be more than 30% again, with the growth drivers are basically domestic and whatever export that USA exports are growing rapidly.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to generate additional business of around INR 30 crores in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: And what I feel, that considering the current business pipeline and the commercial discussions and RFQs that we have received, for '26-'27, additional business expected is around INR 30 crores on consolidated basis.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to invest INR 5 crores in Alkop and around INR 4 crores in Bearings over the next 12 to 15 months.
management_commitments.quote: But these are the next two years, next 12 months to 15 months plan, investment plan. So INR 5 crores in Alkop and around INR4 crores in bearing.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets EBITDA margins of about 23% for next year.
management_commitments.quote: And what we are targeting for next year, the EBITDA margins will be about 23%.

management_commitments.claim: An additional ₹2.50 crore capex is planned for the Brake division over the next 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: ₹0.58 crore fully deployed in FY26 with ₹2.50 crore additional planned over next 2 years

management_commitments.claim: Management expects brake segment revenue to grow from INR 5-6 crores in the first year to INR 25-30 crores within the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: with this in the first year itself, we expect that to start with, we will have a business of around INR5 crores to INR6 crores to start with and eventually it will go up to INR25 crores to INR30 crores within next two years.

management_commitments.quote: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores, subject to good monsoon and geopolitical situation doesn't worsen further.
